updates.title: Simple boot, fresh leads after delete, shared slim UI

sections.heading: Site
added: Home uses the same simple moonrise loading bar as the rest of the app instead of a logo splash animation.
Public pages share one slim type scale with larger titles, lighter body copy, and consistent padding.

sections.heading: Finder
fixes: Deleting a website clears its lead claim so scanning or building that business again treats it as a new lead.

sections.heading: Studio
added: Surface styles ship as studio-ui with Moonrise-only naming in cache keys and asset links.

sections.heading: Studio
added: Moonrise Studio ships the static app and worker for building, selling, and publishing local business websites.
